title: Committees, commissions & reports (Apr-Nov 2025)
quote: 8th CPC ToR flags the unfunded cost of non-contributory pension schemes - a signal against return to OPS

boxes.title: 8th Pay Commission & UPS
items: 8th CPC chair ==**Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai**==; report in **18 months**
Effective **1 Jan 2026**; CPC is **non-statutory**
7th CPC: **Justice Ashok Kumar Mathur**
UPS from **T.V. Somanathan Committee**; indexed to **CPI-IW**
⚠ One-time switch ==**UPS → NPS**==, not to OPS; irreversible

boxes.title: Draft Seeds Bill 2025
items: Replaces **Seeds Act, 1966** + Seeds (Control) Order **1983**
No sale without ==**VCU**-based registration==; **3-year** provisional for existing
Farmers may save/sell farm-saved seed - ⚠ **not under a brand name**
**QR code** labels; traceability on **SATHI Portal**
Penalty: minor up to **₹2 lakh**; major up to **₹30 lakh**

boxes.title: Health & drug safety
items: **Coldrif** syrup: ==**DEG**== - **16 children** died (Rajasthan, MP); revised **Schedule M**
Earlier DEG: **Gambia 2022** (**60**), **Uzbekistan 2023** (**18**)
New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules draft: test licence → intimation; **90 → 45 days**
NCDs = **63%** of deaths; **SDG 3.4**: cut by **one-third** by **2030**
AP: **first** human **H5N1** death (Palnadu, ⚠ **second** in India); confirmed by **NIV, Pune**

boxes.title: Other issues
items: Domestic workers: India voted for ==**ILO C189 (2011)**== but not ratified
Fertiliser: DAP sales **-12.8%**; **20:20:0:13** = **3rd largest** (**69.7 lakh tonnes**)
NE States: only **0.13%** of exports; FMR scrapped **2024**
**Sammakkasagar** barrage on **Godavari**, **Mulugu**: **6.7 tmcft**
Euthanasia: SC **2018** - passive allowed, **Art. 21**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: UPS: **50%** pension after **25 years**; family pension **60%**
GFR direct purchase = ==**₹2 lakh**== (⚠ not ₹5 lakh)
UGC LOCF: **Art. 51A(h)** - scientific temper
SEBI MIIs: at least **two EDs**; ⚠ EDs hold no other directorships
States back to OPS: Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh
